New card proposals v1.0-cards

Every card from the written proposal, drawn the way the game would show it: the opened card, the Deck tile, and a worked example in the Chain. Click a card to approve it, or use the three buttons: Approve, Deny, or Change… to write what you would like different. Your choices are saved as you click. Pictures are rough sketches; final art follows once a card is approved.
